---
title: "Applications"
subtitle: "Case studies on Pakistani data, from raw series to forecast"
toc: false
---

The lectures teach a method and the labs make you practise it. These case studies show the
methods at work on questions people in Pakistan actually ask: where remittances come from,
what we export and to whom, whether tax collections will meet target, and how fast solar
prices are falling. Several of them pull fresh data from the State Bank every time they are
rendered, so the numbers stay current.
